title: v2.payment.get_escrow_detail_batch
label: SHOPEE · API REFERENCE
html:
{"content":"

Use this API to fetch the details of order income by batch.

Request

Request Address

POST/api/v2/payment/get_escrow_detail_batch

Base URL: https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/payment/get_escrow_detail_batch
